children.title: Johnson & Johnson 2022 Financial Results Overview
children.summary: The section outlines Johnson & Johnson's overall financial results for the fourth quarter and full year of 2022, highlighting a reported sales decline of 4.4% in Q4 to $23.7 billion, primarily due to unfavorable foreign exchange and reduced COVID-19 vaccine sales. Full-year sales grew by 1.3% to $94.9 billion, with operational growth of 6.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) decreased by 24.9% in Q4 to $1.33, while adjusted EPS increased by 10.3% to $2.35. The company projects a 4.0% growth in adjusted operational sales for 2023, excluding COVID-19 vaccine sales, and an adjusted EPS of $10.50.
